theorems.name: Submission.dpf_jm_gram_det_eq_det_compression
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (e : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ V) (A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : ι => inner ℝ (A (e i)) (A (e j))) = (V.starProjection ∘L (A.adjoint ∘L A) ∘L V.starProjection + (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - V.starProjection)).det
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
